units: CAGR, drawdown in percent (15.0 = 15%); trade_frac, invested are fractions of NAV
pred_pit_check: log_px median |diff| vs log10(adjusted close) 0.3077, vs log10(raw price) 0.0000 on 102017 scored rows with a later split/bonus
caveats: industry labels are a static 2026 map (not point-in-time)
universe excludes securities with no PIT mcap (mostly delisted/renamed, 2016-2018 heavy)
names that never print again are frozen at their last close (no delisting mark-down)
unadjusted corporate actions in the panel appear as real moves across gaps

columns.era: all = whole window; disc = sessions < 2023-01-01; conf = sessions >= 2023-01-01 (cut from the same NAV path)
columns.cagr_med: median CAGR % over all phase offsets
columns.cagr_worst_all: min CAGR % over all h//5 phases (count differs by hold)
columns.cagr_worst6: min CAGR % over the fixed 6 evenly spaced phases (comparable across holds)
columns.dd_worst6: min max-drawdown % over the fixed 6 phases
columns.trade_frac_med: median over phases of the median per-rotation traded weight sum|dw| (2.0 = full rotation)
columns.invested_mean: mean invested fraction after each rotation's trades
columns.uc_blocked: picks not bought because upper-circuit locked at the entry open (next_open)
columns.no_open: picks with no print at the entry open (next_open)
columns.catchup_exits: sales delayed to the first session the name printed again
columns.pred_pit: MODEL rows: pred passed the point-in-time log_px check
